q1_issues.issue: 'through winter' is a temporal PP answering when/how-long, which the instruction set routes to Time or the interval/duration heads; it is placed in a preposition-named oblique (Through ...) instead, contrary to the direction to decide by the question the PP answers rather than by surface fit.

q2_gaps: temporal 'through/throughout + a bare time-span noun' ('through winter') as the extent of a state - During needs a reified outer eventuality, Time records the season but drops the extent, and Start/End need structured terms, so no licensed head carries it
copular 'stay/remain + adjective' ('stay lit') - the persistence/continuation sense has no licensed carrier (Still is tied to the word 'still'), so only the resulting state is recorded
notes: The indicative conditional as a plain Implication, the donkey-style binding of 'a cove'/'that cove' to one rule variable, 'north' exposed as a positional modifier, LocatedIn for the lanterns' containment, and the reified-state-plus-flat-copular dual emit are all handled per the instruction set; every consequent variable is bound in the premise.
